_help: Project expectations for the QA checks (22-30). Empty values are auto-detected from the site (the most common value wins), so fill them in to check against the CONFIRMED values instead. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_phones: confirmed phone number(s), any format, e.g. ["+91 95128 15630"]. Other numbers on the site are reported.
_address: confirmed street address as it should appear (one line); empty = only check that every page shows the same address
_live_url: the current production site, for 29_live_vs_dev_checker.py (live sitemap + content parity). Can also be passed with --live.
_legal_site: true for law firms: forms must have a required disclaimer checkbox, footer must link a disclaimer page
_forbidden_terms: text that must not appear anywhere on the site (old vendor, old brand, staging names ...). Case-insensitive.
_required_footer_links: words that must appear in a footer link (text or URL)
_social_profiles: expected social profile URLs; empty = only check the ones on the site are real profiles that respond
_spelling_ignore: optional: words the English check (31) must never report. Normally leave it empty - names, brands and the site's own terms are recognised automatically.
_nav_expected: top-level navigation labels that must be in the header (desktop and mobile), e.g. ["Services", "Contact"]
